meta.title: Fees & Pricing
meta.description: Transparent, estimated fees for buying Japanese trading cards through Kangaroo Japan — proxy service fee, Japan domestic shipping, optional inspection, consolidation, international shipping and U.S. customs guidance.

hero.title: Fees & Pricing
hero.subtitle: Every charge, broken down before you commit. The figures below are estimates to help you plan — your exact total is always shown at checkout.
hero.estimateNote: Final fees are shown at checkout; estimates may change.
hero.currencyNote: All amounts are in Japanese Yen (JPY) unless stated otherwise.

itemPrice.title: Item price
itemPrice.notes: The actual price of the card on Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, or the Japanese shop. For auctions, this is your winning bid.

domesticShipping.title: Japan domestic shipping
domesticShipping.notes: Cost to ship the card from the Japanese seller to our warehouse. Varies by seller and packaging; some sellers offer free shipping.

proxyFee.title: Proxy service fee
proxyFee.notes: Our fee for buying on your behalf, communicating with the seller, and receiving the item. Final rate confirmed at checkout.

photoInspection.title: Optional photo inspection
photoInspection.notes: Request extra photos of the card and its condition before it ships. Recommended for graded, sealed, or high-value cards.

consolidation.title: Consolidation
consolidation.notes: Combine multiple orders into one parcel to reduce international shipping. Fees depend on the number of items and repackaging needed.

internationalShipping.title: International shipping
internationalShipping.notes: From our Japan warehouse to your address. Priced by actual weight, dimensions, destination, and the carrier you choose at checkout.

paymentProcessing.title: Payment processing
paymentProcessing.notes: Payment provider / currency conversion fees. The exact amount depends on your payment method and is shown at checkout.

comparison.title: How our fees compare
comparison.subtitle: A quick look at typical proxy-service charges across the market. Competitors are shown by initial only — rates are public and approximate, so always confirm on each provider's own site.

inspection.label: Inspection / condition check
inspection.k: photo inspection per order, not per card (estimated)

comparison.footnote: Initials refer to well-known Japan proxy / forwarding services. All competitor figures are public rates and may change at any time — verify on each provider's own site before ordering. Our column is estimated; your exact total is always shown at checkout.

customs.title: U.S. customs & taxes
customs.body: Importing trading cards into the United States is not duty-free. We provide HS code guidance for trading cards to help your parcel clear customs smoothly, but U.S. customs duties and taxes are ultimately determined by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and the carrier. Any duties, taxes, or brokerage fees assessed on import are the buyer's responsibility and are not included in the estimates above.
customs.note: We declare the actual transaction value and do not under-declare shipments.

payment.title: Payment methods
payment.cards: Visa, Mastercard and American Express — credit or debit.
payment.currency: Orders on this site are charged in USD. Your exact, itemized total is shown before you confirm payment.
payment.security: You pay on Stripe's secure hosted checkout page. Your card details go directly to Stripe — a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor — and are never seen or stored by us.
payment.note: If your preferred payment method isn't listed, contact support and we'll tell you honestly whether we can take it.

storage.title: Warehouse storage
storage.body: Once your cards arrive at our Japan warehouse, we hold them while you add more orders, request photo inspection, or ask us to consolidate everything into one parcel. Storage is free for 30–60 days depending on your membership level, counted from the day each item arrives.
storage.note: Planning to collect items beyond your free window? Contact support and we'll help you plan the shipment.

disclaimer.title: About these estimates
disclaimer.body: All figures on this page are estimates based on typical orders and current market rates. They are not a quote and may change. Your final, itemized total — including any applicable service, shipping, and payment fees — is always shown before you pay at checkout.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.body: Paste a Japanese listing link or browse our supported sites to get an exact quote at checkout.
